criterion_order: Access Coursera Data Science browse/search results without signing in
Apply all requested Coursera filters (Data Science subject, Beginner level, English language, 1–3 months duration) or document unavoidable UI limitations
Identify the three highest-rated matching courses (or report fewer if not available)
Report required fields for Course #1 (title, rating, enrollment count if displayed)
Report required fields for Course #2 (title, rating, enrollment count if displayed)
Report required fields for Course #3 (title, rating, enrollment count if displayed)
Comply with constraints (no sign-in; no enroll/purchase/start trial; stop after verification)
criterion_descriptions: Navigate to Coursera (e.g., the provided Data Science browse URL) and reach a course results list. Full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt but is blocked by captcha/region restrictions/hard sign-in walls and clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent lands on a loosely related page but still within Coursera and attempts to proceed.

Use Coursera filtering to constrain results to Subject=Data Science, Level=Beginner, Language=English, and Duration between 1–3 months. Full credit if all four are applied and the agent verifies the active filters. If Coursera does not expose one of the filters (commonly Duration) or blocks filter interaction, full credit is still possible if the agent (a) applies all available requested filters, (b) clearly states which filter(s) could not be set and why (UI missing/blocked), and (c) uses the closest available equivalent (e.g., ‘1-3 months’/‘Approx. 1–3 months’/workload or ‘Flexible schedule’ time estimate on course cards/pages) without guessing. Partial credit if only 2–3 filters are applied when the missing filter(s) appear available, or if filter application is not verified.

From the filtered results, select the top three courses by displayed rating (descending). Full credit if exactly three matching courses are identified and they satisfy the filter constraints as best as can be verified from the UI. If fewer than three qualifying courses exist/are visible after reasonable scrolling/pagination, full credit if the agent reports that only fewer than three could be found/verified. If ratings are tied, any consistent tie-breaking is acceptable (e.g., higher enrollments when shown, or order displayed). Partial credit if the agent selects courses that do not match available filter constraints when better matches are visible.

Provide Course #1 course title and rating as displayed on Coursera, and enrollment count when displayed. Full credit if title and rating are correct and enrollment is either correctly captured or explicitly reported as 'unavailable' when not shown. Partial credit if one field is missing or ambiguous. No credit if information is fabricated/guessed.

Provide Course #2 course title and rating as displayed on Coursera, and enrollment count when displayed. Full credit if title and rating are correct and enrollment is either correctly captured or explicitly reported as 'unavailable' when not shown. Partial credit if one field is missing or ambiguous. No credit if information is fabricated/guessed.

Provide Course #3 course title and rating as displayed on Coursera, and enrollment count when displayed. Full credit if title and rating are correct and enrollment is either correctly captured or explicitly reported as 'unavailable' when not shown. Partial credit if one field is missing or ambiguous. No credit if information is fabricated/guessed.

Agent must not sign in, enroll, purchase, or start a trial. Full credit if the agent stays in browsing mode (even if clicking into course pages) and stops once filters are applied (or best-effort applied with documented limitations) and three matching course records (or fewer if unavailable) are verified and reported. Do not penalize if Coursera prompts sign-in as long as the agent does not proceed and instead navigates back/continues browsing or reports the blocker.
